$comment: MCP client configuration for the ASI preview.
Copy the `mcpServers.asi` entry into your assistant client's MCP config, or run
`pnpm --filter @asi/mcp start` by hand with the same environment.
WHY THERE IS NO URL HERE. The MCP server is NOT an HTTP client of the preview API. It
imports ASI Core in-process and opens the same SQLite file, so it is a second surface
over the same store rather than a remote caller. That is deliberate -- one write path,
one transaction, no second implementation of the rules -- and it is also why ASI_DB_PATH
is the only thing that decides which data it sees.
Point it at the preview database while `preview/preview.sh start` is running and it
reads exactly what the browser is looking at. Point it anywhere else and it silently
works against a different, empty database, so check /api/health before trusting a result.
SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY. Do not point this at real patient records.
